name: Buckley Carlson
moments: He attacks Hasan Piker and the Young Turks, says Tucker Carlson's left-right unity push with Hunter Biden is a charade, and says the left believes in its cause while the right keeps trying to be liked. He says Marjorie Taylor Greene and Tucker are courting people who hate them.
Hunter Biden wrote a letter of recommendation for Buckley Carlson to get into Georgetown. It doesn't get swampier than that
